newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Citra Marga eyes Africa toll road.
newsitem.headline: Citra Marga eyes Africa toll road.

text.p: Indonesian toll road contractor and operator PT Citra Marga Nusapala Persada (CMNP) is likely to be part of an international consortium building a 600-km toll road in southern Africa, Bisnis Indonesia daily reported on Tuesday.

The daily quoted CMNP's project manager Bambang Hartadi as saying the firm is considering joining a consortium to build the road linking Maputo, the capital of Mozambique, to Johannesburg. The project is valued at $8.4 billion.
"We prefer to become a sub-contractor because the location is quite far from Indonesia and we still have to complete some projects in Indonesia," Hartadi said.
PT Citra Marga Nusapala Persada is controlled by President Suharto's eldest daughter Siti Hardiyanti Rukmana.
